label: Whatever is maximal in being is the first being, i.e. nothing other than it…, from NECESSARY_1 root
meaning: The one connection from the necessary root to a route premise found for #487, at a price: seven non-logical premises in place of the one it concludes, six of them not otherwise premises of a route. Not a discharge. Each clause is omitted in a model with the other six (STMT-NECESSARY-ROUTE-CONTROLS). It needs no inhabitedness premise. It does not conflict with STMT-ORDER-READINGS-DO-NOT-YIELD-FIRST-BEING, whose bundle lacks the bridges into a selected relation and well-foundedness. With two bridges covering every actual concretum in place of the three restricted to necessary beings or to causes of necessity, the same premise follows with no necessity premise (STMT-NECESSARY-ROUTE-CONTROLS).
